title: Operator-Theoretic Stability and Observer Synthesis for Parameter-Dependent Vlasov--Maxwell Dynamics
summary: An operator--theoretic formulation is developed for the synthesis of parameter-dependent controllers and observers for the Vlasov--Maxwell system. The linearized dynamics are modeled as a non-autonomous evolution system whose generators depend on measurable plasma quantities. Well-posedness of the associated evolution family is established together with uniform growth bounds. Parameter-dependent Lyapunov operators yield operator differential LMIs ensuring uniform exponential stability and observer convergence.
